comments.text:
My wife and I have travelled throughout South-East Asia...and there are still more places we want to visit...but some of our most memorable moments are in Cambodia; the people are wonderful and respectful, the young people are whip-smart and can converse in multiple languages, Angkor Wat is amazing...and we will definitely return some day with the kids. 
The portion about people living around the cemeteries in Phnom Penh is correct...but those images are not in Cambodia; judging from the Christian relics and the Spanish names on the tombs, they are most likely in the Philippines.

replies.author: @UnseenWorldDocs_Us
replies.text: Thank you for sharing this — your experience in Cambodia sounds wonderful, especially what you said about the people and Angkor Wat. And great catch on the cemetery footage. The Christian relics and Spanish names are an important clue, so that section may indeed have used footage from the Philippines. Really appreciate you pointing it out respectfully
